messages:
Aleena (CSM): Heads-up: Peregrine Labs go-live w/ dedicated pool next Tue 09:00 PT. Need final owners for quota allocation, autoscale thresholds, load test window, and renewal checkpoint. @Devon can you confirm SRE runbook? @Mia we need traffic profiles. @Sam from Peregrine please confirm test window. TLDR: quota plan + autoscale + smoke + ramp.
Devon (SRE): On it. I'll own the runbook. Proposed autoscale policy: min 4 GPUs, scale step +2, cooldown 60s, max 40. Suggest reserve 10% headroom during first 24h. Will upload policy + SA commands.
Mia (Solutions): Sending traffic profiles — we'll do 3 phases: smoke (50rps), ramp (300rps over 2h), soak (100rps for 6h). k6 script and seed prompts in S3: s3://redwood-test/peregrine/k6-v2.js. Also we'll include 20% high-context requests.
Sam (Peregrine-ops): Confirm 9am PT window ok. Concern: renewal discussion tied to SLOs — can we get 99th perc latency under 400ms for chat? If not, renewal team wants mitigation plan.
Devon (SRE): 99p target depends on model choice. For rtx-6000 models we'll likely hit ~350ms under moderate load with KV cache. If we need stricter we can pin to lower-latency variant. We'll run targeted latency sweep during smoke.
Aleena (CSM): Sam — noted. I'll schedule a renewal sync after test with metrics snapshot. Also need enablement session for Peregrine engineers on traffic shaping + fallback policy. @Mia can you lead?
Mia (Solutions): Yep. Can do a 30m session right after soak. Slide deck + runbook excerpt ready.
Devon (SRE): Prep checklist posted:
```
- confirm quotas: pool size, slot IDs
- prewarm models (kv cache priming)
- deploy autoscale policy
- run smoke, ramp, soak
- capture traces + token counts
- rollback plan
```
I'll tag slot IDs once provisioned.
load-test-bot: k6 job finished (smoke): 50rps, avg latency 120ms, 99p 280ms, errors 0.1% — full report: https://ci.redwood/tests/1715000000-smoke-report
Sam (Peregrine-ops): Nice. 99p 280ms is acceptable. What about CPU/GPU memory during ramp? Need to ensure no OOMs.
Devon (SRE): During ramp we saw GPU mem plateau at 78%; no OOMs. But observed KV cache misses spike at minute ~45 — Mia, can we prime better?
Mia (Solutions): Will update prompt seeds to increase prefix overlap; also bump cache warmup to 30m pre-start. I'll push new seeds to S3.
Aleena (CSM): :thumbsup: thanks all. Action items: Devon upload runbook by EOD, Mia update seeds + host session invite, Aleena to send renewal snapshot template and follow-up with Sam. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10am PT for preflight. @Sam any other blockers?
Sam (Peregrine-ops): No blockers. Appreciate the quick turn. One ask: include billing delta estimate for reserved capacity vs hosted surges.
Aleena (CSM): Adding billing delta to follow-up. Closing thread for now — will post preflight notes tomorrow. :partyparrot:
